svg.text: Uses your µF capacitors • 4.6 kΩ input bias • 100 kΩ output resistor • no firmware changes
RP1–RP4: parallel, not series → 25 Ω total
Wire with USB unplugged and amp off.
All gray wires and GND symbols connect
Use continuity mode to identify each lead:
Center → negative side of C_IN (10 µF).
Plug into the amp’s ¼-inch guitar INPUT.
Power on; check before the amp
Meter black lead → ground. Let DC settle.
A: about 0.04 V; B: about 0 V
Expect quieter, darker sound and possible noise.
Input has no added anti-alias filter.
Start WHITE / clean, with amp volume low.
Mute the amp before reset or reprogramming.
Use onboard Pmod power pins, not DIP pins 6 / 12. DIP 24 is NOT the 3.3 V rail. Keep R_OUT in series with DIP 1.
Replaces the earlier wiring guide. Electrical connections shown; connector positions are simplified, not physical breadboard holes.
